em português, «formado em» é igual ao «d: watch out for false friends: «un stage» is an internship, not a theatre «stage»; «une formation» is a training course or a qualification, not a “formation”; and «une expérience» can also mean a scientific experiment. In the job sense, «de l'expérience» is uncountable and takes the partitive: «J'ai de l'expérience.»

a carta de motivação francesa é curta e: the French cover letter is short and direct: why this job, why me, when can we talk. Avoid vague phrases. English letters often open with a personal pitch; in French, start with the position.

in French, the interviewer uses «vous». Answer in complete sentences, without slang, and avoid one-word answers. When you do not know a word, say «Comment dit-on… ?».
